statements.text: I’ve installed ChatGPT on my phone, so when I need a statistic for my speech or to verify something, I will type it in, but I need to do better. I’m in Congress, and I need to tell the truth. So if I need to know what was the unemployment rate in 1978, it’ll tell me.
statements.venue: NOTUS reporting (republished by Washington Sun) on lawmakers' use of AI
